title: Traveling
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

AtCoDeer the deer is going on a trip in a two-dimensional plane. In his plan, he will depart from point $(0, 0)$ at time $0$, then for each $i$ between $1$ and $N$ (inclusive), he will visit point $(x_i,y_i)$ at time $t_i$.

If AtCoDeer is at point $(x, y)$ at time $t$, he can be at one of the following points at time $t+1$: $(x+1,y)$, $(x-1,y)$, $(x,y+1)$ and $(x,y-1)$. Note that **he cannot stay at his place**. Determine whether he can carry out his plan.

## Constraints

- $1$ $≤$ $N$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $0$ $≤$ $x_i$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $0$ $≤$ $y_i$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $1$ $≤$ $t_i$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $t_i$ $<$ $t_{i+1}$ ($1$ $≤$ $i$ $≤$ $N-1$)
- All input values are integers.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
t_1 x_1 y_1
t_2 x_2 y_2
:
t_N x_N y_N
```

## Output

If AtCoDeer can carry out his plan, print `Yes`; if he cannot, print `No`.

## 题目描述

鹿 AtCoDeer 要在二维平面上进行一次旅行。他计划在时间 $0$ 从点 $(0, 0)$ 出发，然后对于 $1$ 到 $N$（包含两端）之间的每个 $i$，在时间 $t_i$ 到达点 $(x_i,y_i)$。

如果 AtCoDeer 在时间 $t$ 位于点 $(x, y)$，那么在时间 $t+1$ 他可以位于以下四个点之一：$(x+1,y)$、$(x-1,y)$、$(x,y+1)$ 和 $(x,y-1)$。注意，**他不能停留在原地**。请判断他能否按照计划完成旅行。

## 约束条件

- $1$ $≤$ $N$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $0$ $≤$ $x_i$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $0$ $≤$ $y_i$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $1$ $≤$ $t_i$ $≤$ $10^5$
- $t_i$ $<$ $t_{i+1}$（$1$ $≤$ $i$ $≤$ $N-1$）
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入中以以下格式给出：

```
N
t_1 x_1 y_1
t_2 x_2 y_2
:
t_N x_N y_N
```

## 输出格式

如果 AtCoDeer 能够按照计划完成旅行，输出 `Yes`；否则输出 `No`。

samples.note: It is impossible to be at $(100,100)$ two seconds after being at $(0,0)$.
